svg.text: Laps: where the start line counts
Each panel plays its moves with the engine; "laps" is the completed laps after each.
The pit lane has its own forwardIndex scale: its dots do not compare with lane 1.
Main lanes: crossing the start line completes a lap
The line is just before zone 1, in whatever lane you are.
The same in lane 2, whose zones run on to 30 before the line
The outer lanes have more cells per lap, so their zone numbers wrap later.
Behind the line at the start: the first crossing only begins lap 1
A car dealt a row behind the line has -1; its first crossing makes 0 (no toast, no sound).
In the pit lane the line is the PIT_LINE cell
Landing on Z01_L0_00 (under the start line) crosses it, as in F1.
A whole stop credits one lap: entering does not, the line does, the box does not
Z27_L1_00 to the entry (before the line), to the line, then the box.
The pit exit onto lane 1 never credits
Landing on forwardIndex 6 is not a wrap.
